# Versance design tokens and component specs

Source of truth for building in the Versance style (web app + extension style-v1). Developer system: /admin/system/

# Design tokens

Named values for the Versance interface, based on the web app (versance.html) and the extension style-v1. Use the token, never the raw value.

## CSS

```css
/* Versance design tokens: based on the web app (versance.html) and the browser-extension design style-v1 (browser-extension/style-v1/design-system/tokens.css).
   One token per line with its use as the trailing comment: the docs, tokens.json and the skill are generated from this file.
   Source tag at the start of each comment (tools/audit.py checks [app], [ext] and [both] values against the source files):
     [both] the same value is in versance.html and in style-v1
     [ext]  from style-v1 (the extension: indigo accent, 14px body)
     [app]  from the web app versance.html (:root, white sidebar, green accent)
     [ours] chosen for the admin tool; neither source defines it */
:root {
  /* Color: text */
  --color-text: #000000;                     /* [both] body text (--ink) */
  --color-text-on-dark: #ffffff;             /* [both] text and icons on the dark sidebar and on filled buttons */
  --color-text-muted: #65728e;               /* [both] labels, captions (--muted) */
  --color-text-faint: #8d96aa;               /* [both] placeholders, disabled text (--faint) */

  /* Color: brand (extension indigo) */
  --color-primary: #324efe;                  /* [ext] the one accent (--accent): links, active states, primary buttons, focus */
  --color-primary-hover: #2c45e0;            /* [ext] primary hover (--accent-hover) */
  --color-primary-dark: #263bc1;             /* [ext] primary pressed (--accent-pressed) */
  --color-primary-tint-8: #eff1ff;           /* [ext] hover on rows and rail buttons (--accent-tint-8) */
  --color-primary-tint-15: #e0e4ff;          /* [ext] selected pill, citation chip (--accent-tint-15) */
  --color-primary-tint-25: #ccd3ff;          /* [ext] disabled primary button, low-emphasis outlines (--accent-tint-25) */
  --color-accent: #324efe;                   /* [ext] the active-item bar in the admin sidebar (the accent) */

  /* Color: surfaces and lines */
  --color-ink: #0a1922;                      /* [both] near-black: the admin sidebar and the dark pill button (--exception-dark) */
  --color-ink-soft: #0d2030;                 /* [app] hover on the dark sidebar (the web app's dark-theme sidebar) */
  --color-surface: #ffffff;                  /* [both] cards, menus, inputs (--panel, --bg) */
  --color-page-bg: #f9f9f9;                  /* [ext] page tint, code boxes, tool pane (--pane) */
  --color-surface-alt: #f3f5f9;              /* [both] chips, tiles, hover fills (--hover) */
  --color-border: #d9dde5;                   /* [both] borders and rules (--line) */
  --color-border-light: #f3f5f9;             /* [both] row dividers (--line-soft, --line2) */
  --color-hover: #f3f5f9;                    /* [both] round icon button hover */
  --color-link-underline: rgba(50, 78, 254, 0.4); /* [ours] underline on admin links */
  --color-backdrop: rgba(10, 25, 34, 0.5);   /* [ours] dimmed backdrop behind the menu drawer */
  --color-disabled-bg: #f3f5f9;              /* [ours] disabled fill */
  --color-disabled-text: #8d96aa;            /* [both] disabled text (--faint) */

  /* Color: status */
  --color-success: #5ac47e;                  /* [app] the web app's green (--accent, --green): toggle on, "ask" actions */
  --color-success-bg: #def3e5;               /* [app] pale green fill (--accent-bg) */
  --color-success-text: #1c6b38;             /* [app] text on the pale green (--accent-text) */
  --color-danger: #dc2927;                   /* [ext] high severity (--risk-high) */
  --color-danger-bg: #fce8e8;                /* [ours] pale red fill */
  --color-danger-text: #a51d1b;              /* [ours] text on the pale red */
  --color-warning: #f59d0a;                  /* [ext] medium severity (--risk-medium) */
  --color-warning-bg: #fef2db;               /* [ours] pale amber fill */
  --color-amber: #e2b43d;                    /* [both] news tag, "create" actions (--tag-news, --amber) */

  /* Color: source tags */
  --color-tag-filing: #324efe;               /* [ext] filing tag in the extension (--tag-filing) */
  --color-tag-filing-app: #2b40c5;           /* [app] filing tag in the web app (--col-filing) */
  --color-tag-transcript: #ea5b5b;           /* [both] transcript tag (--tag-transcript, .tg.transcript) */
  --color-tag-web: #65728e;                  /* [both] web tag (--tag-web, --col-web) */

  /* Color: web app (versance.html) */
  --app-sidebar-bg: #ffffff;                 /* [app] the web app's white sidebar (--sidebar-bg) */
  --app-nav-active: #c7e2f0;                 /* [app] active sidebar item fill (.navbtn.active) */
  --app-accent: #5ac47e;                     /* [app] the web app's accent (--accent) */
  --app-accent-dark: #3da865;                /* [app] accent hover (--accent-d) */
  --app-accent-bg: #def3e5;                  /* [app] selected pill, send button fill (--accent-bg) */
  --app-accent-text: #1c6b38;                /* [app] text on the accent fill (--accent-text) */

  /* Color: web app dark theme (reference only: the admin is light) */
  --app-dark-bg: #0a1922;                    /* [app] dark theme page (--bg in the dark :root) */
  --app-dark-sidebar: #0d2030;               /* [app] dark theme sidebar and panels */
  --app-dark-line: #1a3040;                  /* [app] dark theme borders */
  --app-dark-hover: #152838;                 /* [app] dark theme hover and chips */
  --app-dark-text: #f3f5f9;                  /* [app] dark theme text */
  --app-dark-accent-bg: #0d2a18;             /* [app] dark theme selected fill */
  --app-dark-accent-text: #7dd498;           /* [app] dark theme accent text */

  /* Typography */
  --font-family: "Figtree", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; /* [both] the typeface of the web app and the extension */
  --font-family-mono: "Roboto Mono", monospace; /* [app] the web app composer and code */
  --letter-spacing: 0;                       /* [app] the web app sets none (the hero title uses -0.5px) */
  --font-size-md: 14px;                      /* [ext] body text (--fs-body) */
  --line-height-md: 21px;                    /* [ext] body line height (--lh-body 1.5) */
  --font-size-lg: 18px;                      /* [ext] help title (--fs-help-h1) */
  --line-height-lg: 22.5px;                  /* [ext] help title line height (1.25) */
  --font-size-title: 28px;                   /* [app] page title (.hero h1) */
  --line-height-title: 34px;                 /* [ours] page title line height */
  --font-weight-title: 700;                  /* [app] page title weight */
  --font-size-table: 14px;                   /* [ext] table text (--fs-body) */
  --line-height-table: 21px;                 /* [ext] table line height */
  --font-size-nav: 13px;                     /* [app] sidebar item text (.new-btn 13px) */
  --line-height-nav: 20px;                   /* [ours] sidebar item line height */
  --font-size-thead: 11px;                   /* [ext] table head, uppercase caps (--fs-caps) */
  --line-height-thead: 16px;                 /* [ours] table head line height */
  --font-size-caption: 12px;                 /* [ext] captions, code badges (--fs-small) */
  --line-height-caption: 18px;               /* [ours] caption line height */
  --font-weight-regular: 400;                /* [ext] body (--fw-regular) */
  --font-weight-semibold: 600;               /* [ext] pane titles, selected pills (--fw-semibold) */
  --font-weight-bold: 700;                   /* [ext] buttons, tags, nav (--fw-bold) */
  --font-weight-thead: 600;                  /* [ext] table head */

  /* Radius */
  --radius-cite: 4px;                        /* [ext] citation chip (--r-cite) */
  --radius-tag: 6px;                         /* [ext] source tags (--r-tag) */
  --radius-sm: 8px;                          /* [ext] buttons, small cards (--r-btn) */
  --radius-box: 10px;                        /* [ext] inputs, tab strip (--r-box) */
  --radius-panel: 12px;                      /* [ext] cards and tiles (--r-panel) */
  --radius-pill: 999px;                      /* [both] pills, tabs, sidebar items, toggles */
  --radius-round: 50%;                       /* [ext] icon buttons, send button, dots */

  /* Spacing */
  --space-1: 4px;                            /* [ours] admin scale */
  --space-2: 8px;                            /* [ours] admin scale */
  --space-3: 12px;                           /* [ours] admin scale */
  --space-4: 16px;                           /* [ours] admin scale */
  --space-5: 20px;                           /* [app] web app sidebar padding */
  --space-6: 24px;                           /* [ours] admin scale */
  --space-8: 32px;                           /* [ours] admin scale */
  --space-10: 40px;                          /* [ours] admin scale */
  --pad-btn: 7px 13px;                       /* [ext] button padding (--pad-btn) */
  --pad-pill: 6px 12px;                      /* [ext] pill padding (--pad-pill) */
  --page-padding: 40px;                      /* [ours] main area padding */
  --card-padding: 24px;                      /* [ours] card padding */

  /* Elevation */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); /* [app] resting card (--shadow-sm) */
  --shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); /* [app] composer, menus, popovers (--shadow) */
  --shadow-lg: 0 16px 40px rgba(10, 25, 34, 0.3); /* [ours] dialogs and the System menu drawer */

  /* Motion */
  --duration-hover: 0.15s;                   /* [ext] colour fades (--dur) */
  --duration-fast: 0.12s;                    /* [ext] button and nav hover (--dur-fast) */
  --duration-menu-item: 0.15s;               /* [ext] same as hover */
  --ease-standard: ease;                     /* [ours] transition timing */
  --focus-ring: 2px solid #324efe;           /* [ext] keyboard focus on buttons and links, with a 2px offset (--focus-ring) */

  /* Layout */
  --sidebar-width: 230px;                    /* [app] the web app sidebar width (.sidebar) */
  --rail-width: 40px;                        /* [ext] the extension icon rail (--rail-w) */
  --content-max-width: 1200px;               /* [ours] admin content width */
  --nav-indicator-height: 3px;               /* [ours] active item bar in the admin sidebar */
  --header-height: 64px;                     /* [ours] phone header */
}
```


# Components

Specs for the Versance admin components. Each lists the values; build with the tokens in `design-tokens.md`.

## Admin shell

Dark left nav with the Versance logo and pill items, and a content area. Collapses to a top bar below 720px, where the menu opens inside the header and pushes the page down.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sidebar | fill var(--color-ink), width var(--sidebar-width) (the web app's 230px), sticky and full height; logo 160px wide, padding 24px |
| Item | pill (var(--radius-pill)), 13px / 600, padding 7.5px 12px, 12px side margin, hover white at 12%, 120ms |
| Active item | white at 18% fill; no side bar |
| Main | padding var(--page-padding), white on the Public and System pages |
| Mobile | at 720px the sidebar becomes a 64px top bar; the arrow button opens the menu inside the header |

```css
.side{width:var(--sidebar-width);background:var(--color-ink);color:var(--color-text-on-dark)}
.side nav a{margin:0 12px 4px;padding:7.5px 12px;border-radius:var(--radius-pill);font:600 var(--font-size-nav)/var(--line-height-nav) var(--font-family)}
```

## Buttons

Extension buttons: 8px radius, 14px text. One primary, an outline for secondary actions, a near-black pill.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base | padding var(--pad-btn), 1px var(--color-border) border, radius var(--radius-sm), var(--font-size-md); hover border and text var(--color-primary), 120ms |
| Primary (.p) | fill var(--color-primary), white text; hover var(--color-primary-hover); pressed var(--color-primary-dark) |
| Primary disabled | fill var(--color-primary-tint-25), white text, not-allowed |
| Outline (.o) | var(--color-primary) text, 1px var(--color-primary-tint-25) border; disabled tints lighter |
| Dark pill (.dark) | fill var(--color-ink), white text, radius var(--radius-pill): the one deliberate non-indigo control (Web Search On) |
| Tile button | var(--color-hover) fill, no border, full width (Upload a document) |
| Focus | var(--focus-ring) with a 2px offset on every button, link and role=button |

```css
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:var(--pad-btn);border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);transition:border-color var(--duration-fast),color var(--duration-fast)}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--color-primary);color:var(--color-primary)}
.btn.p{background:var(--color-primary);border-color:var(--color-primary);color:#fff}
.btn.p:hover{background:var(--color-primary-hover)}
```

## Pills and tabs

Pill-shaped chips and tabs. Selected state is the pale indigo tint.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Pill | padding var(--pad-pill), radius var(--radius-pill), var(--color-surface-alt) fill, var(--color-text-muted) text; hover var(--color-border) fill and black text |
| Selected pill | var(--color-primary-tint-15) fill, var(--color-primary) text, weight 600 |
| Tab strip | 4px padding, #E6E6E6 fill, radius var(--radius-box); tab padding 4px 12px, pill radius; active tab white with black text |
| Web app pill (.cpill.on) | var(--app-accent-bg) fill and var(--app-accent-text) text, 12.5px |

```css
.cpill{display:inline-flex;gap:7px;padding:var(--pad-pill);border-radius:var(--radius-pill);background:var(--color-surface-alt);color:var(--color-text-muted)}
.cpill.is-selected{background:var(--color-primary-tint-15);color:var(--color-primary);font-weight:600}
```

## Toggle and send

The 26 x 15 toggle and the round send button.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Toggle | 26 x 15px, radius var(--radius-pill), var(--color-border) off, var(--color-primary) on; 11px white knob, 2px inset, 180ms; the web app's on colour is var(--color-success) |
| Send | 36px circle, var(--color-primary) fill, white icon; hover var(--color-primary-hover); disabled var(--color-primary-tint-25) until there is content |
| Web app send | var(--app-accent-bg) fill with var(--app-accent-text) icon; hover fills var(--app-accent) with white |

```css
.tog{width:26px;height:15px;border-radius:var(--radius-pill);background:var(--color-border)}
.tog.on{background:var(--color-primary)}
.send-btn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--color-primary);color:#fff}
```

## Fields

Text input and select: 10px radius, 1px border that turns indigo on focus (no ring).

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Field | padding 10px 14px, 1px var(--color-border) border, radius var(--radius-box), white; placeholder var(--color-text-faint) italic |
| Focus | border var(--color-primary) only: no outline, no offset |
| Select | padding 12px 14px, same border and radius; keeps the focus ring |

```css
.field{width:100%;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius-box)}
.field:focus{border-color:var(--color-primary);outline:none}
```

## Icon rail

The extension's vertical rail of 30px icon buttons, with a count badge.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rail | var(--rail-width) wide, 10px gap, centred |
| Button | 30px, radius var(--radius-box), white; hover var(--color-primary-tint-8); active var(--color-primary) fill with white icon |
| Badge | 14px minimum, var(--color-primary) fill, white 9px / 700, top-right; on the active button it inverts (white fill, indigo text) |

```css
.rail-btn{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:var(--radius-box)}
.rail-btn.active{background:var(--color-primary);color:#fff}
```

## Pane, tile and card

Surfaces in the extension: the grey tool pane, dismissible tiles and bordered cards.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Pane | var(--color-page-bg) (#F9F9F9) |
| Tile | var(--color-hover) fill, radius var(--radius-panel), padding 16px 40px 16px 16px; a 20px round close button top right (indigo, hover var(--color-primary-tint-15)) |
| Info tile | white with a 1px var(--color-border-light) border |
| Card | white, 1px var(--color-border) border, radius var(--radius-panel), padding 12px 14px |
| Web app card | var(--color-surface-alt) fill, radius 16px, padding 18px 20px, 13px / 600 muted heading |

```css
.card{background:var(--color-surface);border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius-panel);padding:12px 14px}
```

## Source tags and severity

Small solid tags for the source of an answer, and uppercase severity pills.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source tag | 10px / 700, letter-spacing .4px, white on colour, padding 3px 8px, radius var(--radius-tag) |
| Colours | filing var(--color-tag-filing) (the web app uses var(--color-tag-filing-app)), transcript var(--color-tag-transcript), web var(--color-tag-web), news var(--color-amber) |
| Severity | 12px / 700 uppercase, letter-spacing .02em, white on colour, padding 4px 10px, pill; High var(--color-danger), Medium var(--color-warning) |
| Low risk | no style is defined: no reference design shows one |

```css
.tg{font:700 10px var(--font-family);letter-spacing:.4px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:var(--radius-tag);color:#fff}
.risk{font:700 12px var(--font-family);text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:var(--radius-pill);color:#fff}
```

## Citation, rows and info text

The inline citation chip, document rows and the indigo help text.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Citation | 16px minimum, var(--color-primary-tint-15) fill, var(--color-primary) 10px / 700, radius var(--radius-cite) |
| Doc row | padding 10px 4px, 1px var(--color-border-light) divider; hover var(--color-primary-tint-8); date in var(--color-text-muted), tabular numbers |
| Info text | var(--color-primary); title 18px / 700 (line 1.25), sub-heads 14px / 700 |
| Link | var(--color-primary), underlined; hover var(--color-primary-hover) |

```css
.cite{min-width:16px;height:16px;padding:0 4px;background:var(--color-primary-tint-15);color:var(--color-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-cite);font:700 10px var(--font-family)}
```

## Web app sidebar

The web app's white sidebar: the New button and the pill nav items (these are the web app's own values, not the admin's).

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sidebar | 230px wide, var(--app-sidebar-bg), padding 20px, hairline var(--color-border) on the right |
| New button | pill, var(--color-surface-alt) fill, 13px / 500, a 20px black round plus icon; hover var(--color-border) |
| Nav button | pill, 14px, var(--color-text-muted); hover var(--color-surface-alt) and black; 6px gap between items |
| Active | var(--app-nav-active) (#C7E2F0) fill, black text, weight 600 |

```css
.navbtn{display:flex;gap:9px;padding:7.5px 10px;border-radius:999px;color:var(--color-text-muted)}
.navbtn.active{background:var(--app-nav-active);color:#000;font-weight:600}
```

## Web app composer

The web app's message box: 20px radius, mono text, pill row below.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Box | white, 1px var(--color-border) border, radius 20px, var(--shadow), padding 16px 16px 13px |
| Text | var(--font-family-mono) 15px / 1.55, placeholder var(--color-text-faint) |
| Send | 36px circle bottom right, var(--app-accent-bg) fill, var(--app-accent-text) icon |

```css
.composer{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:16px 16px 13px}
```

## Icon link

The admin's quiet action: a text link with an 18px icon, no fill or border.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Text | var(--font-size-md) / 600, var(--color-primary), no underline at rest |
| Icon | 18px Material icon in currentColor, 4px from the text |
| Hover | var(--color-primary-hover) with a 2px-offset underline, 150ms |
| Focus | 2px outline var(--color-primary) |
| Where | versance-admin/admin/admin.css (.ilink) |

```css
.ilink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--space-1);color:var(--color-primary);font:600 var(--font-size-md)/var(--line-height-md) var(--font-family)}
.ilink:hover{color:var(--color-primary-hover);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
```

## List table with developer row

The Public page list: group heading rows, one row per page, a twisty that opens the route, source files and spec link.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Head cell | 11px / 600 uppercase, letter-spacing .04em, 1px var(--color-border-light) rule |
| Body cell | 14px / 21px, padding 8px, 51px rows |
| Group row | bold 14px heading with a 20px chevron that folds the group's rows; the count sits at the right |
| Developer box | var(--color-page-bg), 1px var(--color-border), radius var(--radius-sm), padding 16px |

```css
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}
th{font:600 var(--font-size-thead)/var(--line-height-thead) var(--font-family);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
td{padding:8px;font-size:var(--font-size-table);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border-light)}
```
